#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os

files = ["/root/work/test.py", "/root/work/results.json"]
for f in files:
    print(f"===== {f} =====")
    if os.path.exists(f):
        with open(f, "r") as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        print(content)
    else:
        print(f"[NOT FOUND] {f}")
    print()
